products.name: ÓLNATURE'S Advanced Foaming Face Wash
products.subtitle: ÓLNATURE'S Advanced Foaming Face Wash is an gentle yet effective cleanser specifically formulated for acne-prone and oily skin types. Enriched with Mandelic Acid, Salicylic Acid, and Azelaic Acid, this paraben-free foaming face wash helps regulate excess sebum production, unclog pores, and remove dead skin cells. It promotes a clearer, smoother complexion by keeping pores clear and balanced without stripping natural skin moisture.

products.name: BioWallice SKARSTAT Face Serum
products.subtitle: BioWallice SKARSTAT Face Serum is an advanced targeted formula designed to fade blemishes, dark spots, and stubborn acne scars. Powered by potent brightening ingredients including Claritea, Alpha Arbutin, Niacinamide, Tyrostat, and 4- , this high-performance serum works deep within the skin layers to reduce hyperpigmentation and reveal an even-toned, luminous complexion. Perfect for daily use to enhance skin clarity and skin texture.
